baseline_models.focus_anchor: The named rabbaniyyun and ahbar are the subjects expected to yanha, while the closing predicate condemns what people yasna'un.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nurture-and-repair branch of r-b-b and the book-scholar branch of h-b-r define learned authority as formative upkeep. Joined to restraint and skilled making, the verse treats silence as failure to maintain the community, not merely failure to utter a rule.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and checking of an act supply the office's missing intervention.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the rabbani role formative rather than honorific.
The scholar who possesses the book supplies accountable learned office.
Skilled hand-production turns recurring misconduct into something socially made and maintained.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks why scholars did not state a prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The verse indicts learned offices for failing to form and maintain a community in which the practice is actually arrested.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: One preposition governs both qawlihim al-ithm and aklihim al-suht, and the censure ends with yasna'un.
baseline_models.mechanism: Circulating speech, appropriation of wealth, erasing illicit gain, and accommodation by money can form one production chain: discourse legitimates extraction, extraction strips moral standing, and elite accommodation keeps both reproducible.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people supplies the public narrative layer of the mechanism.
Consumption as taking or using wealth supplies the extractive material layer.
Stripping and eradication describe the gain as consuming the order that permits it.
Disgraced illicit wealth fixes the material object of the coordinated speech-consumption pair.
Accommodation through money or flattery supplies a plausible elite maintenance channel.

changed_reading.before: Sinful speech and illicit eating are two adjacent offenses.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as coupled outputs of an accommodated speech-and-extraction system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-ithm, al-suht, kanu, and yasna'un combine delay, stripping, durative recurrence, and making.
baseline_models.mechanism: The delay-from-good branch of ithm and the stripping branch of suht make the offense temporal and material: repeated failure to stop a lag from the good hardens into a practice that erodes its own sustaining order.

activation_trace.role: Delay from the good supplies the temporal drift at the start of the mechanism.
Stripping and eradication supply the cumulative material result of that drift.
Occurrence present through time gives the conduct a durative, recurrent frame.
Making an act supplies the conversion of repeated delay into an established product.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists completed moral violations.
changed_reading.after: It also diagnoses a process in which delayed correction accumulates into self-eroding institutional practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah assigns rapid transgressive action to many people and closes with ya'malun. The focus ayah repeats the offense bundle but names learned authorities and closes with yasna'un, shifting causal attention from visible acts to the skilled social production that non-restraint permits.

activation_trace.role: Speed as the opposite of delay marks the offenders' accelerating visible behavior.
Crossing the limit in injustice defines the behavior's outward transgressive course.
Purposive action supplies the individual-act predicate replaced by manufacture in the focus.
Formative repair identifies the authorities whose omitted intervention changes the causal frame.
Skilled production recasts repeated acts as a maintained institutional output.

structural_cues: 5:62 and 5:63 repeat ithm, eating suht, bi'sa, ma, and kanu, while changing both the salient agent and the final verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the tight repetition and the ya'malun-to-yasna'un shift; I infer that leadership omission helps produce the practice, while a live alternative is that yasna'un only intensifies the same censure without reallocating causality.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoing belongs to the people who hurry into it.
changed_reading.after: Their acts remain theirs, but the next ayah exposes a second causal layer: learned non-restraint helps manufacture the durable practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Establishing what was sent is followed by eating from above and below and by a moderate community, while 5:75 presents eating food as ordinary creaturely dependence. These cues revise the focus from a condemnation of consumption into a contrast between extractive consumption and an ordered provision regime.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and establishment supply the condition for an ordered provision system.
Eating as the yield of tree and field renders consumption as received fruitfulness.
The upper direction supplies one pole of provision surrounding the community.
The lower direction completes the spatial image of provision from the whole environment.
Moderation between extremes supplies the social form paired with lawful provision.
Literal taking of food shows that embodied eating itself is not the condemned mechanism.
Tasting and taking food fixes the ordinary creaturely object of consumption.
Taking wealth contrasts extractive appropriation with the received yield in 5:66.
Eradication makes illicit gain a mode of consumption that destroys its sustaining order.
Nurturing repair links learned restraint to restoration of the provision order.

structural_cues: 5:66 repeats r-b-b and eating but reverses illicit consumption through a conditional sequence of establishing revelation, encompassing provision, and moderation.
5:75 separates ordinary eating of food from the focus ayah's marked object al-suht.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conditional order, the spatial food image, moderation, and ordinary eating; I infer that learned correction helps mediate a just provision order, while the live alternative is direct divine reward with no implied social-economic mediation.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns appetite and illicit intake.
changed_reading.after: It discriminates between provision received within an established, moderate order and extraction that strips that order, making leadership's task restorative as well as prohibitive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger passage states that omission of the defining act amounts to non-delivery of the message. Applied cautiously to the named learned offices in the focus, failure to restrain is not a minor lapse beside their role; it tests whether the role is being performed at all.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply an office defined by accountable transmission.
Delivering the message supplies the indispensable action by which the office is measured.
Actualized action marks the condition whose omission nullifies claimed delivery.
Rabbanic knowledge supplies one learned office tested by its conduct.
The book-scholar supplies the parallel office whose title cannot substitute for intervention.
Active checking of wrongdoing is the omitted performance under scrutiny.

structural_cues: 5:67 uses a counterfactual equation: if the defining act is not done, the message has not been delivered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies that office-performance criterion for the messenger; I extend it analogically to learned offices in 5:63, while a live alternative is that the prophetic commission is unique and cannot define the rabbaniyyun or ahbar.

changed_reading.before: The scholars retain their standing despite one neglected duty.
changed_reading.after: Their neglected restraint can be read as evidence that the learned office itself is not being enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same n-h-y root later describes the speakers reaching an end to what they say, followed by the open question of repentance and forgiveness. External restraint in the focus is therefore oriented toward self-cessation and reparative return before painful consequence reaches them.

activation_trace.role: Reaching an endpoint turns prohibition into the target state of actual cessation.
Uttered speech is again the conduct that must be brought to an end.
An effect reaching and touching them supplies the consequence before which cessation matters.
Calling another to repent supplies a remedial aim for authoritative correction.
Covering the fault and protecting from its effect supplies the possible result of return.
Merciful tenderness keeps the correction from collapsing into punitive denunciation.
External checking remains the focus ayah's immediate means toward cessation.
Nurturing repair identifies the learned role suited to corrective return.

structural_cues: 5:73 joins non-cessation, saying, and impending painful contact; 5:74 immediately asks about repentance and seeking forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, consequence, repentance, forgiveness, and mercy in sequence; I infer that learned prohibition should facilitate a turn, while a live alternative is that warning and mercy are juxtaposed without any mediating role for the authorities.

changed_reading.before: Nahy is an authoritative ban whose success is exhausted by being announced.
changed_reading.after: Nahy aims to bring the harmful speech to an endpoint and reopen a path of return, so mere denunciation without cessation or repair remains incomplete.

context_deltas.mechanism: Censure is said to have come on prophetic tongues because of disobedience and transgression, and the next ayah explains that the community did not mutually restrain one another from recognized wrong. The named scholars in the focus are thus nodal authorities whose task includes making restraint circulate through the community.

activation_trace.role: The tongue as delivery of a message supplies the already-voiced authoritative warning.
Departure from obedience identifies the conduct to which warning should answer.
Crossing limits in injustice shows the repeated social motion of the wrong.
Reciprocal checking makes restraint a community relation, not only a top-down utterance.
The reprehensible thing that is to be repelled supplies a socially recognizable object of restraint.
Actualized conduct shows that mutual correction must interrupt deeds, not merely classify them.
Rabbanic learning supplies a node capable of teaching and distributing the restraining norm.
Book-based learned authority supplies the second accountable node in that network.

structural_cues: 5:78 gives a prior prophetic tongue of censure and 5:79 immediately names failure of reciprocal tanahi as the explanatory wrong.
5:79 repeats kanu, nahy, bi'sa, ma, and a doing predicate from the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voiced prophetic censure and failed mutual restraint; I infer that the authorities in 5:63 should propagate a community practice of correction, while a live alternative keeps 5:63 strictly about elites and 5:79 strictly about everyone else.

changed_reading.before: The focus assigns prohibition exclusively to two elite classes.
changed_reading.after: It holds those classes responsible as relay points for a distributed norm in which people actively restrain one another from enacted wrong.

context_deltas.mechanism: Other religious specialists are marked by non-arrogance; hearing then becomes understanding, recognition of truth, public saying, inscription among witnesses, and reward because of what was said. This positive chain reverses both sinful speech and learned silence in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Priestly leaders supply a positive comparison class of religious specialists.
Devotion born of reverent fear supplies a receptive rather than self-protective posture.
The negated grandeur and pride branch removes status-defense from religious authority.
Hearing as understanding and compliance begins the positive speech-forming sequence.
Recognition through a distinguishing sign converts hearing into discernment.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the recognized content of the new utterance.
Voiced speech externalizes recognition as accountable public commitment.
Entering a name into a register turns utterance into durable communal placement.
Testimony as declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the public norm of truthful speech.
The return of an act as reward confirms that this speech has consequential value.
What they said is explicitly retained as the ground of the positive outcome.
Corresponding recompense completes the speech-to-consequence chain.
Circulating sinful speech supplies the negative public discourse that the positive chain reverses.
The book-scholar anchors the comparison back in the focus ayah's learned authority.

structural_cues: 5:82-85 forms a sequence from humble religious specialists through hearing, recognition, saying, inscription, witness, and recompense.
The phrase about what they said in 5:85 reverses the focus ayah's phrase about their sinful saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the full positive sequence and the verbal reversal; I infer that learned restraint should cultivate truthful witness as a replacement discourse, while a live alternative treats the later group only as a contrast in reception, not a prescription for the offices in 5:63.

changed_reading.before: The authorities' task is to suppress bad statements.
changed_reading.after: Their fuller task is to sustain a hearing-recognition-witness pipeline that replaces corrosive speech with accountable, consequential speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claim of a bound divine hand is countered by spread hands that spend, after which the ayah depicts recurring war-fires and corruption. The sequence can activate sinful speech in the focus as scarcity discourse that licenses extraction, accommodation, and destructive competition.

activation_trace.role: An uttered proposition supplies the scarcity claim and its consequential public repetition.
A collar binding the limb materializes the proposition as constrained agency.
Spreading and extension directly reverse the constricted-hand image.
The outward movement of wealth supplies abundance's economic action.
Repeated ignition supplies the social conflict that a destructive discourse can feed.
Cooling and stilling flame supplies the counter-action to recurring escalation.
Departure from sound order names the social result of the sequence.
Circulating speech anchors the scarcity proposition to the focus ayah's condemned saying.
Taking wealth supplies the extraction that scarcity discourse may normalize.
Disgraced illicit gain fixes the economic result as morally corrupt.
Accommodation by money supplies the possible institutional channel joining discourse to gain.

structural_cues: Within 5:64 a spoken constriction claim is corrected by expansive spending, then followed by recurrent war ignition and corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the speech, constriction-expansion reversal, spending, fire, and corruption; I supply the arrow from scarcity discourse to illicit extraction and conflict, while the live alternative is that these are adjacent indictments with no causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Sinful saying and illicit gain are unspecified parallel wrongs.
changed_reading.after: One exploratory mechanism reads the saying as a scarcity narrative that helps make extraction and corrosive competition seem necessary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates ink, crafted appearance, and paid accommodation around ahbar and yasna'un. It remains anchored in the focus's scholar, speech, illicit wealth, and making terms, plus the contrasting positive inscription in 5:83; downstream prose must present it as a possible media-production mechanism, not an allegation of textual forgery.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-ahbar, qawlihim, aklihim al-suht, and yasna'un permit a branch-level model of learned media craft serving extraction.

activation_trace.role: Writing ink makes the learned office materially capable of fixing and circulating discourse.
Speech spreading among people supplies the content that learned media can stabilize.
Taking wealth supplies the material beneficiary of the discourse.
Illicit disgraced gain keeps the media model tied to the verse's named object.
Crafted appearance supplies rhetorical polishing that can make a corrupt practice look proper.
Accommodation through money supplies the incentive linking polish to illicit gain.
Positive inscription into a witness community supplies the clean counter-use of durable textual placement.

changed_reading.before: The ahbar merely remain silent while others speak and consume.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, learned media craft may polish and stabilize the discourse that launders extraction, in contrast to inscription among truthful witnesses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the hydrological branch of n-h-y into institutional function. It remains anchored in yanha, the nurturing rabbani office, and suht's stripping action, while later overflow and rivers provide a controlled contrast; downstream prose must label it a material analogy rather than a lexical translation of prohibition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yanha can activate the place where a torrent reaches its end and settles, beside rabbani repair and consumption of what strips away.

activation_trace.role: A pool where torrent water reaches its end supplies the catchment image for effective restraint.
Nurturing repair gives the learned office the function of settling and redirecting destructive flow.
Stripping and eradication describe what an uncontained social flow does to its channel.
Easy abundant overflow supplies a later beneficial flow produced by recognition rather than extraction.
A river cutting a channel through earth supplies the ordered-flow contrast to stripping consumption.

changed_reading.before: The authorities should issue a verbal stop command.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they should function as a social catchment where destructive momentum reaches an end and is redirected into life-bearing flow.

strongest_changes: The 5:62-63 repetition shifts the diagnosis from fast individual action to learned non-restraint as a layer of social manufacture.
The eating reversals in 5:66 and 5:75 distinguish extractive suht from ordinary dependence and provision within an established, moderate order.
The n-h-y echoes in 5:73 and 5:79 redefine prohibition as achieved cessation, reparative return, and a distributed practice of mutual restraint.
The 5:82-85 sequence reverses sinful saying through humble hearing, recognition, witness, and recompense because of what was said.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reuses the focus ayah's speech, eating, restraint, learned-role, and censure structures, but changes their predicates and outcomes: action becomes manufacture, illicit intake becomes encompassing provision, elite prohibition becomes mutual restraint, and condemned saying becomes rewarded witness.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from scarcity discourse to illicit extraction is reader-supplied and may be only a juxtaposition.
The office-nullification logic of 5:67 may be unique to the messenger rather than transferable to learned authorities.
The scribal and catchment readings are branch-driven analogies and should not displace the stronger institutional and reciprocal models.
